New `minds-admin workspaces repair-record-ids` (dry-run by default, `--execute` to apply): re-aligns pool leases whose services agent id drifted from the owner's workspace record -- the slow-path rebuilds created before the imbue_cloud plugin pinned the rebuilt container to the lease's agent id. Each lease-holding row whose agent id names no client-written record is repointed to the owner's client-written record for the same host when exactly one exists (record-less rows, ambiguous ones, and rows whose only other records for the host have the stub shape too are reported and skipped, nothing of their hosts deleted), and the lease-time stubs that leaves orphaned are deleted, all in one transaction of compare-and-swap writes. Safe to re-run; scheduled in `apps/minds/docs/deploy/next_deploy.md` for staging and production after the release deploys (imbue-ai/mngr-internal#1159).

The connector's user-id-prefix rule (the 16-hex `leased_to_user` / bucket-owner key) now has one home in minds_admin, `primitives.derive_user_id_prefix`, used by the record-id repair, the R2 bucket sweep, and the cutover drivers instead of three separate copies.
